early_sample_definition: Either team has fewer than six prior eligible same-season regular games
calibration: Expanding earlier early-season games only; minimum 50; no regression fitting
score_formula: Existing _calibrate_nba_projections with explicitly blended scoring/conceding stats, no form double-count, injuries/standings/odds omitted, home advantage only when not neutral
probability: Normal margin residual CDF; bias, spread and absolute-error intervals calibrated on earlier seasons only
production_promotion: Forbidden in this experiment; research disabled by default; prospective collection required
nba_holdout_note: Ending 2026 excluded from this experiment, but already used by earlier project scoring research; not globally untouched
prospective_holdout: All games after protocol timestamp; no outcomes used until a later authorized evaluation
